address: Via Vittorio Veneto 22, Trezzano sul Naviglio, 20090, Italy
bio: Housed in a majestic historic farmhouse, this small friendly restaurant boasts intimate dining rooms and attractive “shabby-chic” style furnishings. In summer, the delightful outdoor space in the internal courtyard offers an idyllic setting. Traditional Milanese cuisine is the star of the show here, including specialities such as risotto with roasted bone-marrow, mondeghili meatballs and delicious breaded veal cutlet, also available in an “imperial” version for sharing....
